system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: When an agent starts, it sees the names and descriptions of available refinery skills. The full skill text is loaded only when the agent judges that the skill is relevant to the current task.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; role prompts plus progressively disclosed skills.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the dispatcher creates an experiment workspace by copying the upstream topic, landscape, latest idea, and latest proposal, and by initializing STATE.md, LESSONS.md, and experiment-log.md.
env_context_strategy.note: Artifact files seeded into workspace plus agents reading workspace; paper only.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config surface available. Critics use fresh contexts but no compaction mechanism described.

observation_format.note: Paper only; tool observation format not described.

tool_call_format.note: Paper only; underlying backends (Claude Code, Codex) not specified at this level.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in evidence; notify_user, ask_user, send_file mentioned.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper only; no dependency list available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The system then pairs a role that produces the artifact with an independent critic that checks it against an explicit standard.
loop_primitives.note: Producer-critic loops within a factory pipeline (idea, proposal, experiment, paper); prompt dispatcher. event_driven weakly inferred from dispatcher; paper only.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: STATE.md records the current experimental state details and paper-level argument.
planning_granularity.note: Scientist writes plans; STATE.md re-read across iterations.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: deep-literature-dispatcher generates search queries, merges and filters candidate papers, selects papers for full-text reading, launches reader agents
multi_agent_topology.note: Top dispatcher over factory dispatchers launching worker agents; 18 roles.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: the human defines the standards the critics enforce, resolves questions the loops cannot settle, and remains the final adversary who can block any artifact from advancing.
human_in_loop.note: Also ask_user via Telegram on blocking; topic drafts human-reviewed.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: STATE.md records the current experimental state details and paper-level argument.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the literature wiki and landscape provide shared memory that later factories can reuse.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Inter-agent handoff is therefore mediated by artifacts, which makes the research process recoverable, auditable, and reusable across projects.

self_verification.evidence_quote: The critic works in a fresh context and, where possible, on a different model, so the artifact advances only after it has survived an attempt to break it.
self_verification.note: Reviewers, auditors, killer reviewer, area-chair adjudicator.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: Proposal refinement stops when proposal-reviewer marks the proposal as ready or the proposal reaches the version limit.

rollback.note: Paper only; git mentioned for artifacts but no revert mechanism.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: If the reviewer returns ready, the experiment stage ends.
termination_condition.note: Version limit in proposal factory (Sec. 3.3); idea stop rule v >= s-2.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Agon supports per-role model and tool configuration, motivated by research quality and cost control.

execution_isolation.note: Coders deploy to remote servers; agent runtime boundary not described.

filesystem_access.note: File permissions mentioned in Sec. 2.1 but not specified.

tracing.evidence_quote: The audit system tracks time, cost, context usage, and tool use for each invocation, and attributes these records to the corresponding research stage and role.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We present Agon, a research orchestrator that validates what can be checked inside the workflow and leaves the remaining judgments to human scientists.

open_source.evidence_quote: Agon is open-source, built entirely from natural-language prompts, and will be released at AutoResearch-Factory/Agon.
open_source.note: Announced, not yet released; no licence seen.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The current system supports at least Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek, Kimi, and GLM.

pinned_version.note: No repo/tag in evidence; paper arXiv:2606.24177v1.
